metadata.note: Caribbean context: Sir George Walter Highway (Antigua). Q4bi 2m: p_truck = 945×20 = 18 900 kg m/s west. Q4bii 4m: conservation — both at rest after → v_car = 18900/630 = 30 m/s east. Q4c 3m: a = (45-20)/10 = 2.5 m/s². Combined into one file.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2022 Q4b/c — Momentum Conservation and Acceleration (Sir George Walter Highway)
question.text:
A truck, of mass 945 kg, heading west on the Sir George Walter Highway slammed head-on at 20 m s⁻¹ into a car of mass 630 kg, heading east.

(b)(i) Calculate the initial momentum of the truck. (2 marks)

(b)(ii) If both vehicles come to rest after the collision, calculate the initial velocity of the car. (4 marks)

(c) The velocity of a car increases from 20 m s⁻¹ to 45 m s⁻¹ in 10 s. Calculate the acceleration of the car. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q4b(i) — Initial momentum of truck:

p = mv = 945 × 20 = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ (westward)

Q4b(ii) — Initial velocity of car:

By the law of conservation of momentum, total momentum before = total momentum after.

Both vehicles come to rest → total momentum after = 0.

Taking west as positive:
p_truck + p_car = 0
(945 × 20) + (630 × (−v_car)) = 0
18 900 = 630 × v_car
v_car = 18 900 / 630 = 30 m s⁻¹ (eastward)

Q4c — Acceleration:

a = (v − u) / t = (45 − 20) / 10 = 25 / 10 = 2.5 m s⁻²

steps.label:
Truck: m_T = 945 kg, v_T = 20 m/s west  |  Car: m_C = 630 kg, v_C = ? east
After collision: both at rest (total momentum = 0)
Law of conservation of momentum: total p before = total p after
Calculate the initial momentum of the truck. (2 marks)
Calculate the initial velocity of the car (conservation of momentum). (4 marks)
Calculate the acceleration of the car (20 m/s → 45 m/s in 10 s). (3 marks)

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Use p = mv, where m is mass in kg and v is speed in m/s.

fields.label: Conservation equation (state the momentum principle applied): _____
fields.expected: Total momentum before = total momentum after
fields.diagnostic_hint: Since both vehicles come to rest, total momentum after = 0. So total momentum before must also equal 0 (conservation).

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Apply the law of conservation of momentum: total momentum before the collision = total momentum after. Since both are at rest after, total momentum after = 0, so total momentum before = 0.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: v_car = p_truck / m_car = 18 900 / 630 = 30 m s⁻¹ (eastward). The car must have had exactly equal and opposite momentum to the truck.
